jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

jobs.title: Content Creator - YouTube
jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead Volta's non-US tax compliance and operations and coordinate group tax accounting and reporting. You will build a dependable operating framework as the number of entities, jurisdictions and projects grows.

Reporting to the Tax Director, you will manage the non-US compliance and indirect tax managers, own group provision delivery, and work closely with Finance and the US tax team. This is a practical leadership role combining technical review, team management and the development of scalable processes.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead non-US corporate tax compliance, reviewing computations, returns, payments and elections prepared by the team and local advisers, with clear review and approval controls.

  • Own the group tax provision and reporting timetable, consolidate US and non-US inputs, and review current and deferred tax, effective tax rate reconciliations, tax losses and uncertain positions under the applicable reporting framework, including ASC 740.

  • Coordinate US provision and reporting inputs with the US Compliance and Operations Manager and US Tax Director, agreeing common reporting standards and deadlines.

  • Manage and develop the two non-US managers, allocate workloads and oversee VAT/GST, customs and other indirect tax operations through the specialist manager.

  • Build and maintain compliance calendars, tax account reconciliations, review controls, evidence standards and audit trails, including readiness for applicable SAO and internal control requirements.

  • Lead tax data, systems and process improvements with Finance, establishing dependable inputs from accounting, procurement and other teams.

  • ACA, ACCA, CTA, CA or an equivalent professional qualification.

  • Hands-on experience delivering group tax provisions and reviewing current and deferred tax, with strong ASC 740 experience desirable.

  • Ability to lead specialist managers and review significant indirect tax issues with appropriate technical support.

jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest die operativen Systeme einer wachsenden Agentur verantworten und Prozesse bauen, die auch ohne dich funktionieren? Operations ist bei EVOLVE der Hebel, der das ganze Team schneller macht. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass Ziele, Prozesse und Automationen im Alltag perfekt ineinandergreifen. 

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Im wöchentlichen Check-in fällt dir auf, dass drei Quartalsprojekte seit zwei Wochen stillstehen. Du fragst nicht nach dem Status, sondern schaust dir den Prozess dahinter an. Gemeinsam mit dem Teamlead gehst du den Ablauf durch: Die Zahlen liegen verteilt an 3 unterschiedlichen Orten und müssten jeden Montag von Hand zusammengetragen werden. Kein Wunder, dass es nicht passiert.

Du baust den Ablauf neu. Es entsteht ein Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichen und Fristen, die Zahlen laufen automatisiert in ein Dashboard. Umgesetzt mit unserem Prozess-Team.

Im Reporting an die Geschäftsführung liegt der Zielfortschritt jetzt jede Woche auf dem Tisch. Einen Tag später nimmst du dir schon den nächsten Bottleneck vor. Nicht weil sich jemand beschwert, sondern weil dir ineffiziente Abläufe von selbst auffallen.

Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote seit Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert Operations bei EVOLVE

Nur Prozesse, die nachgehalten werden, haben Wirkung. Diese Rolle lebt deshalb vom Tagesgeschäft und von Details, nicht von reiner Strategiearbeit. Genau darin liegt ihr Hebel.

  • Ziele bis in den Alltag. Jahres- und Quartalsziele werden zu Maßnahmen, Meilensteinen und Check-ins, die wirklich stattfinden

  • Automation statt Handarbeit. Was zweimal manuell passiert, läuft danach über Make, n8n oder Claude

  • KI als Werkzeug im Alltag. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Jeder nutzt KI wie einen Junior an seiner Seite, um besser und effizienter zu arbeiten

  • Das EVOLVE OS hält all das zusammen. Ziele, Prozesse, Automationen und KI sind bei uns kein Flickenteppich, sondern ein System hinter unserer Dienstleistung. Du sorgst dafür, dass es im Alltag funktioniert und laufend besser wird

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Ziele operativ machen: Du übersetzt Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar

  • Operative Abläufe: Du steuerst die Abläufe innerhalb der Agentur, bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen bis Onboarding

  • Automationen: Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Du setzt selbst um oder mit Unterstützung unseres Teams

  • Datenanalyse: Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten dort, wo sie gebraucht werden, und betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag mit Check-ins und Remindern

  • Bottlenecks: Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Engpässe im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du arbeitest mit den Teamleads aller sechs Fachbereiche auf Augenhöhe, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen. Für die technische Umsetzung von Automationen steht dir unser AI- und Prozess-Team zur Seite. Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld

  • Du kennst Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana und verstehst Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n 

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Teamleads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie Claude und ChatGPT. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur um Texte zu erstellen
